tools.name: audit_smart_contract_code
tools.description: Statically audits Solidity, Vyper, or Move smart contract source code for honeypot transfer taxes, hidden mint backdoors, proxy upgrade traps, and reentrancy. Use when auditing smart contract source code or bytecode before deploying or interacting with a protocol; for scanning Solana Anchor/Rust programs specifically for Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) signer/account vulnerabilities, use scan_solana_cpi_reentrancy instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'code_or_address' ('chain' defaults to 'evm_solidity'), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (45 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

code_or_address.description: Smart contract source code snippet, ABI, or contract address to audit.

chain.description: Target blockchain VM architecture; defaults to 'evm_solidity' when omitted.

annotations.title: EVM & Move Smart Contract Honeypot, Tax & Reentrancy Auditor

tools.name: scan_solana_cpi_reentrancy
tools.description: Scans Solana Anchor and native Rust program instructions for unverified Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) program IDs, missing signer checks, and PDA bump seed canonicalization bugs. Use when auditing Solana Rust/Anchor source code or instruction account structs for CPI privilege escalation; for checking live SPL token mint/freeze authorities and rug-pull risk by mint address, use evaluate_solana_token_risk instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'rust_source_or_idl' ('framework' defaults to 'anchor'), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (30 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

rust_source_or_idl.description: Solana Rust/Anchor source code or IDL JSON string to scan for CPI vulnerabilities.

framework.description: Solana program framework used; defaults to 'anchor' when omitted.

annotations.title: Solana Anchor & Rust Cross-Program Invocation (CPI) Vulnerability Scanner

tools.name: evaluate_solana_token_risk
tools.description: Evaluates Solana SPL and Token-2022 rug-pull risk by checking mint/freeze authorities, permanent delegates, transfer hooks, and returning reason codes with slot height. Use when making a pre-trade security decision on whether an SPL or Token-2022 mint is safe to trade; for DEX liquidity and metadata lookup via x402, use inspect_solana_token_liquidity instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'token_address' ('risk_profile' defaults to 'strict_decentralized'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

token_address.description: Base58-encoded Solana SPL token mint address (32–44 characters).

risk_profile.description: Tolerance policy for centralized freeze authorities; defaults to 'strict_decentralized' when omitted.

annotations.title: Solana SPL Token Mint/Freeze Authority & Rug-Pull Risk Evaluator

tools.name: inspect_solana_token_liquidity
tools.description: Retrieves canonical Solana SPL token metadata including name, ticker symbol, decimal precision, and current mint/freeze authority addresses. Use when resolving SPL token decimals, ticker symbols, and registry metadata for portfolio or swap formatting; for computing a composite security risk score and binary should_transact verdict, use evaluate_solana_token_risk instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'mint' ('network' defaults to 'mainnet-beta'), supports '?demo=true' or x402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

mint.description: Base58-encoded Solana SPL token mint address (e.g. 'EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v').

network.description: Solana cluster to query; defaults to 'mainnet-beta' when omitted.

annotations.title: Solana SPL Token Metadata, Decimals & Authority Registry Lookup

tools.name: track_solana_whale_flows
tools.description: Tracks 24-hour net accumulation or distribution flows across top Solana whale wallets and flags coordinated insider wallet clusters for a given SPL token. Use when analyzing on-chain smart-money order flow and holder clustering on Solana; for checking static SPL contract mint/freeze authority permissions, use evaluate_solana_token_risk instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'token' ('window' defaults to '1h'), supports '?demo=true' or x402 (50 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

token.description: Base58 Solana SPL token mint address or ticker symbol to track whale flows for.

window.description: Aggregation lookback window for net whale flow; defaults to '24h' when omitted.

annotations.title: Solana Whale Wallet Net-Flow & Insider Cluster Tracker

tools.name: estimate_solana_priority_fees
tools.description: Calculates optimal Solana compute-unit (CU) microlamport priority fees and Jito bundle tip lamports to achieve target block-inclusion probability. Use when setting SetComputeUnitPrice and Jito tips before broadcasting a Solana transaction; for querying Bitcoin L1 sat/vB mempool fee rates, use estimate_bitcoin_mempool_fees instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'priority_level' ('tx_type' defaults to 'simple_transfer'), supports '?demo=true' or x402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

priority_level.description: Target inclusion urgency tier on Solana mainnet-beta.

tx_type.description: Transaction category used to estimate compute unit limit; defaults to 'dex_swap' when omitted.

annotations.title: Solana Compute-Unit Priority Fee & Jito MEV Tip Estimator

tools.name: decode_eip712_permit_signature
tools.description: Decodes EIP-712 and Uniswap Permit2 off-chain typed-data payloads to verify spender identity, detect unlimited (uint256.max) token approvals, and flag expired deadlines. Use when inspecting an off-chain eth_signTypedData_v4 or Permit2 payload before signing; for decoding raw on-chain hex transaction calldata (0x...) for eth_sendTransaction, use simulate_evm_transaction_calldata instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'typed_data_json' ('chain_id' defaults to '1'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

typed_data_json.description: JSON string or object containing the EIP-712 / Permit2 message (spender, amount, deadline).

chain_id.description: EVM chain ID used to verify canonical router spender addresses; defaults to '8453' (Base) when omitted.

annotations.title: EIP-712 Typed Data & Uniswap Permit2 Phishing Signature Decoder

tools.name: simulate_evm_transaction_calldata
tools.description: Decodes raw EVM hexadecimal transaction calldata (0x...) by 4-byte function selector to expose hidden ERC-20 approve/transferFrom calls, setApprovalForAll drains, and multicall bundles. Use when auditing raw hex transaction data (to, value, data) before broadcasting an on-chain EVM transaction; for inspecting off-chain EIP-712 JSON typed-data signatures, use decode_eip712_permit_signature instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'calldata_hex' ('network' defaults to 'base_mainnet'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

calldata_hex.description: Hexadecimal EVM transaction data string starting with '0x' (e.g. '0x095ea7b3000000000000000000000000...').

network.description: Target EVM network for simulation context; defaults to 'base_mainnet' when omitted.

annotations.title: Pre-Sign EVM Hex Calldata Selector Decoder & Drain Simulator

tools.name: evaluate_dex_mev_risk
tools.description: Evaluates decentralized exchange (DEX) swap parameters against pool depth and mempool visibility to quantify MEV sandwich risk and compute optimal slippage tolerance in basis points. Use when configuring slippage tolerance and private-RPC routing before executing an on-chain DEX token swap; for comparing cross-chain bridge settlement routes across different L1 blockchains, use compare_crosschain_bridge_routes instead. Read-only edge call (32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'pair' ('execution_venue' defaults to 'uniswap_v3_public'), uses '?demo=true' or L402 (25 sats); HTTP 400 if invalid.

pair.description: Trading pair symbol or pool identifier (e.g. 'ETH/USDC' or 'SOL/USDC').

execution_venue.description: Target DEX protocol or RPC relay; defaults to 'uniswap_v3_public' when omitted.

annotations.title: Pre-Swap DEX MEV Sandwich & Frontrunning Risk Evaluator

tools.name: detect_address_poisoning_scam
tools.description: Compares a target recipient wallet address against recent transaction history to detect vanity prefix/suffix lookalike spoofing and zero-value dusting attacks. Use when verifying a recipient EVM or Solana wallet address before sending funds; for decoding hex smart contract calldata payloads, use simulate_evm_transaction_calldata instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'target_address' ('address_standard' defaults to 'auto_detect'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

target_address.description: Candidate recipient EVM (0x...) or Solana Base58 wallet address to verify.

address_standard.description: Address encoding format; defaults to 'auto_detect' when omitted.

annotations.title: Counterparty Address Poisoning & Vanity Prefix/Suffix Spoof Detector

tools.name: verify_http402_payment_challenge
tools.description: Decodes inbound HTTP 402 Payment Required challenges (L402 BOLT11 + Macaroon, x402 Solana USDC, MPP Base intents) to verify cryptographic payment-hash binding and block overcharge fraud. Use when auditing a 402 challenge header before an autonomous agent pays a Lightning invoice or USDC transfer; for checking on-chain Bitcoin L1 mempool feerates, use estimate_bitcoin_mempool_fees instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'www_authenticate' ('protocol_hint' defaults to 'L402'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (15 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

www_authenticate.description: Raw WWW-Authenticate or Payment-Required HTTP header string from a 402 response.

protocol_hint.description: Expected HTTP 402 payment protocol; defaults to 'L402' when omitted.

annotations.title: Pre-Payment HTTP 402 (L402 / x402 / MPP) Invoice & Macaroon Fraud Verifier

tools.name: estimate_bitcoin_mempool_fees
tools.description: Fetches real-time Bitcoin mainnet mempool feerate recommendations in satoshis per virtual byte (sat/vB) across fastest, half-hour, hour, and economy confirmation tiers. Use when checking current Bitcoin L1 network congestion before broadcasting an on-chain BTC transaction; for calculating exact SegWit/Taproot UTXO batch consolidation vByte weights and dust thresholds, use plan_bitcoin_utxo_consolidation instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'confirmation_target', supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

confirmation_target.description: Target confirmation speed tier; defaults to 'half_hour' when omitted.

tools.name: plan_bitcoin_utxo_consolidation
tools.description: Analyzes a set of Bitcoin UTXO balances in satoshis to compute exact vByte transaction weight, identify uneconomical dust inputs, and recommend whether to consolidate now or hold. Use when optimizing on-chain Bitcoin treasury UTXO sets to minimize long-term miner fee drag; for fetching current live Bitcoin mempool sat/vB feerates alone, use estimate_bitcoin_mempool_fees instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'utxos_sats_json' ('script_type' defaults to 'p2wpkh_segwit'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

utxos_sats_json.description: JSON array or comma-separated list of UTXO values in satoshis (e.g. '[1200, 45000, 85000]').

script_type.description: Bitcoin input script type determining vByte weight per input; defaults to 'p2wpkh_segwit' when omitted.

annotations.title: Bitcoin SegWit/Taproot UTXO Dust Consolidation & Fee-Window Planner

tools.name: calculate_spot_swap_rate
tools.description: Calculates instantaneous spot exchange rates and equivalent USD, BTC, and satoshi values across BTC, ETH, SOL, SUI, and USDC. Use when converting a token amount into USD or satoshis for invoice pricing or accounting; for quoting executable non-KYC cross-chain bridge routes with bridge fees and settlement times, use compare_crosschain_bridge_routes instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'currency' ('amount' defaults to 'standard'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

currency.description: Source asset ticker symbol to convert from.

amount.description: Quantity of the source asset to convert; defaults to 100 when omitted.

annotations.title: Cross-Asset Spot Exchange Rate & Satoshi Conversion Calculator

tools.name: compare_crosschain_bridge_routes
tools.description: Compares non-custodial, non-KYC cross-chain swap routes (THORChain native L1 swaps, Maya Protocol, Blockstream Liquid) by basis-point fee, net output sats, and settlement time. Use when routing cross-chain treasury settlements (e.g. Solana USDC or Base ETH into native Bitcoin); for calculating mid-market spot exchange rates without bridge routing fees, use calculate_spot_swap_rate instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'from_asset' ('to_asset' defaults to 'BTC_NATIVE'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (20 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

from_asset.description: Origin chain asset identifier to bridge from.

to_asset.description: Destination chain asset identifier; defaults to 'BTC_NATIVE' when omitted.

amount.description: Input asset amount to quote; defaults to 100.0 when omitted.

annotations.title: Non-KYC Cross-Chain Bridge Route & Settlement Fee Comparator
